##### refreshOutstanding()

```ts
refreshOutstanding(readSettlement): Promise<void>;
```

Best-effort remote refresh before an owner-local archive transaction. Confirmed
settlements are recorded by Shiitake; unreadable targets leave their local
accepted receipt outstanding for busySync to refuse.

### machineAgentCodecs

### machineAgentReservations()

```ts
function machineAgentReservations(sql): (reservation) => object;
```

Machine-homed Agent identities in the ordinary directory over the enrollment's
own store: one Team identity per enrollment receipt, reserved without opening a
hosted Agent. The enrolling member is the grant actor.
